{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders and remove QA orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
clean_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Parse revenue
clean_df['revenue'] = clean_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if channel is confounded with customer_segment
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
crosstab = pd.crosstab(clean_df['channel'], clean_df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n", crosstab)

# Check conversion rates by channel
conversion_by_channel = clean_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:\n", conversion_by_channel)

# Check conversion rates by customer_segment
conversion_by_segment = clean_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by customer segment:\n", conversion_by_segment)

# Check if the difference in conversion rates by channel is confounded
# Since the email channel was targeted at loyal customers, who have higher conversion rates,
# we must stratify by segment to isolate the campaign effect

# Compute conversion rate within each segment, by channel
stratified_conversion = clean_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')
print("\nConversion rate by channel and customer_segment:\n", stratified_conversion)"}
